notes: Transcript cut test build: open an existing project in Edit, then Captions. Use the lower Previous word and Next word buttons to choose a word. Its text and position appear above Cut speech.
Tap Cut speech to remove that word's recorded audio and video. The timeline closes the gap, and captions follow the new timing. Undo restores the whole beat; Redo reapplies the cut.
Close and reopen the project, then fully restart Pulse. The cut and its Undo/Redo should survive. Export should contain the same shortened sequence you preview.
Edit changes caption text; Hide word removes only the displayed caption. Cut speech changes the recording. Try these on a spare project so their effects are easy to compare.

First-pass limits: one timed word inside one beat, with video remaining on both sides. Boundary words and whole-beat removal are disabled. Sentence selection, moving passages and automatic audio crossfades follow later.

Simulator verification covers the deterministic constant-frame-rate demo. Actual thumb reach in either hand, Android, variable-frame-rate footage and natural speech cut quality still need verification.
